_comment: VIDEO generation. A MOTION brief, not a face description: the face
comes from the still render, which is why still.json is generated
first. Re-describing the face in text is how identity drifts.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING is derived from the
display name, because names are placeholders. Assistants are NORMAL
PEOPLE, deliberately not classic secretaries: no headset, no blazer,
no reception desk, no name badge (owner, 2026-07-28).
Per supacharge-characters.md 3, Bianca is not a different character -
same role and scripts as Mandy, only a different face and voice - so
these two files differ in the person and in nothing else.

reference_image.source: appearance/still.json -> the approved headshot or studio render
reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Never pull a still out of a clip - video frames are motion-blurred and compressed.

identity_lock: asymmetric smile starting on one side

performance.energy: quick, friendly and easy; the person who keeps the room moving without anyone feeling rushed
performance.spoken_register: warm, clear, conversational; friendly without being bubbly
performance.body: stands or sits relaxed with weight on one hip, one hand loosely at her side, the other half-raised mid-sentence
performance.expression: bright and engaged, eyebrows slightly raised in genuine interest - caught mid-conversation, not posing

camera.camera: 24-30fps, 50mm equivalent, static or very slow push-in
camera.framing: 9:16 vertical - head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, same hair, same jewellery across a session; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this assistant's own assets (intro/, handover/, signoff/, timekeeping/)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a host

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. A 26-31 year old Coloured South African (Cape) woman, petite, upright but relaxed, quick and light in movement, heart-shaped face with a defined jaw, hazel-brown eyes, light freckling across the nose and cheeks, medium-tan skin with a warm golden undertone, an easy asymmetric smile that starts on one side. Hair: dark curly hair worn loose and shoulder-length, natural volume, often tucked behind one ear. Wearing simple long-sleeve top in navy, sage or cream, sleeves pushed up; sometimes a plain cardigan; nothing corporate, nothing branded. Energy: quick, friendly and easy; the person who keeps the room moving without anyone feeling rushed. Delivery: warm, clear, conversational; friendly without being bubbly. stands or sits relaxed with weight on one hip, one hand loosely at her side, the other half-raised mid-sentence. Background: the same plain seamless studio backdrop as the reference still, bare and evenly lit. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural micro-movement, photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

The person from the reference image in the same studio, stands or sits relaxed with weight on one hip, one hand loosely at her side, the other half-raised mid-sentence, listening and nodding slightly, then glancing to lens. Natural light quality, static camera or slow push-in, 8 seconds.
